Standing setting: let $X$ be a metric space, let $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and $F, G \subseteq X$. Assume that $(a, q, K, \sigma_1, \sigma_2, F, G)$ carries the project structure $\mathrm{ProofData}$, which consists of the following data and hypotheses.
(1) (KernelProofData) $X$ carries a doubling measure structure with constant $A = 2^a$: $X$ is complete and locally compact, equipped with a Borel measure $\mu$ (its volume) that is locally finite, nonzero, and doubling: $\mu(B(x,2r)) \le 2^a \mu(B(x,r))$ for all $x \in X$, $r \in \mathbb{R}$; moreover $4 \le a$.
(2) (CompatibleFunctions with constant $A = 2^a$) There is a type $\Theta$ together with an injective map $\Theta \to C(X,\mathbb{R})$ (we identify $\vartheta \in \Theta$ with the continuous real function it gives) and, for every $x \in X$ and $r \in \mathbb{R}$, a pseudometric $d_{x,r}$ on $\Theta$, such that: there is a point $o' \in X$ with $\vartheta(o') = 0$ for all $\vartheta \in \Theta$; for all $x, r$ and $\vartheta, \vartheta' \in \Theta$, $\sup_{z, z' \in B(x,r)} |\vartheta(z) - \vartheta'(z) - \vartheta(z') + \vartheta'(z')| \le d_{x,r}(\vartheta,\vartheta')$; if $B(x_1,r_1) \subseteq B(x_2,r_2)$ then $d_{x_1,r_1} \le d_{x_2,r_2}$; if $\mathrm{dist}(x_1,x_2) < 2r$ then $d_{x_2,2r} \le 2^a d_{x_1,r}$; if $B(x_1,r) \subseteq B(x_2, 2^a r)$ then $2 d_{x_1,r} \le d_{x_2,2^a r}$; and for all $x, r$ and every $\rho \in \mathbb{R}$, every $d_{x,r}$-ball of radius $2\rho$ in $\Theta$ is covered by at most $2^a$ $d_{x,r}$-balls of radius $\rho$.
(3) ($K$ is a one-sided Calderón–Zygmund kernel) $(x,y) \mapsto K(x,y)$ is measurable; $|K(x,y)| \le 2^{a^3}/V(x,y)$ for all $x, y$, where $V(x,y) = \mu(B(x, \mathrm{dist}(x,y)))$ (as a real number); and whenever $2\,\mathrm{dist}(y,y') \le \mathrm{dist}(x,y)$, $|K(x,y) - K(x,y')| \le (\mathrm{dist}(y,y')/\mathrm{dist}(x,y))^{1/a}\, 2^{a^3}/V(x,y)$.
(4) ($\Theta$ is $\tau$-cancellative with $\tau = 1/a$) For all $x \in X$, $r > 0$ and $\varphi : X \to \mathbb{C}$ with $\|\varphi\|_{\mathrm{Lip}(x,r)} < \infty$ and $\{\varphi \neq 0\} \subseteq B(x,r)$, and all $\vartheta, \vartheta' \in \Theta$: $\big|\int_X e^{i(\vartheta(y) - \vartheta'(y))}\varphi(y)\,d\mu(y)\big| \le 2^a \mu(B(x,r))\, \|\varphi\|_{\mathrm{Lip}(x,r)}\, (1 + d_{x,r}(\vartheta,\vartheta'))^{-1/a}$, where $\|\varphi\|_{\mathrm{Lip}(x,r)} = \sup_{z \in B(x,r)} |\varphi(z)| + r \sup_{z \ne z' \in B(x,r)} |\varphi(z) - \varphi(z')|/\mathrm{dist}(z,z') \in [0,\infty]$.
(5) $q \in (1, 2]$; $F$ and $G$ are bounded and measurable; $\sigma_1, \sigma_2$ are measurable with finite ranges and $\sigma_1 \le \sigma_2$ pointwise.
(6) $Q : X \to \Theta$ is a (measurable) simple function, and for every $\theta \in \Theta$ the operator $T_Q^\theta$ has bounded strong type $(2,2)$ with constant $2^{a^3}$: for every $f : X \to \mathbb{C}$ that is essentially bounded with support of finite measure, $T_Q^\theta f$ is a.e.-strongly measurable and $\|T_Q^\theta f\|_{L^2(\mu)} \le 2^{a^3}\|f\|_{L^2(\mu)}$. Here $T_Q^\theta f(x) = \sup_{R_2 \in \mathbb{R}} \sup_{0 < R_1 < R_2} \sup_{x' \in B(x,R_1)} \big|\int_{\{y : R_1 < \mathrm{dist}(x',y) < \min(R_2, R_Q(\theta,x'))\}} K(x',y) f(y)\,d\mu(y)\big| \in [0,\infty]$, with $R_Q(\theta,x') = \sup\{r \in \mathbb{R} : d_{x',r}(\theta, Q(x')) < 1\} \in [0,\infty]$.
Let $o \in X$ be the point $\mathrm{cancelPt}(X)$, a fixed choice of point with $\vartheta(o) = 0$ for all $\vartheta \in \Theta$. Let $D = 2^{𝕔 a^2} \in \mathbb{N}$, where $𝕔$ is the project's natural-number constant `𝕔` (by its docstring, fixed equal to $100$), let $\kappa = 2^{-10a}$, and let $S \in \mathbb{N}$ be the least natural number $n > 0$ such that $-n \le \sigma_1(x)$ and $\sigma_2(x) \le n$ for all $x \in X$ and $F, G \subseteq B(o, D^n/4)$.
Assume further a tile structure with parameters $Q, D, \kappa, S, o$, consisting of:
(i) a grid structure: a finite type of cubes $I$, each with a set $I \subseteq X$ (also written $I$), a scale $s(I) \in \mathbb{Z}$ and a center $c(I) \in X$, such that $I \mapsto (I, s(I))$ is injective; $s(I) \in [-S, S]$; there is a top cube $I_0$ with $s(I_0) = S$, $c(I_0) = o$ and $I \subseteq I_0$ for all cubes $I$; for every cube $I$ and integer $k$ with $-S \le k < s(I)$, $I$ is contained in the union of the cubes $J$ with $s(J) = k$; if $s(I) \le s(J)$ then $I \subseteq J$ or $I \cap J = \emptyset$; $B(c(I), D^{s(I)}/4) \subseteq I \subseteq B(c(I), 4D^{s(I)})$; for every $t \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ with $D^{-S - s(I)} \le t$, $\mu(\{x \in I : \mathrm{infdist}(x, X \setminus I) \le t D^{s(I)}\}) \le 2 t^\kappa \mu(I)$; and every cube is measurable. Cubes are ordered by $I \le J$ iff $I \subseteq J$ and $s(I) \le s(J)$.
(ii) a finite type $\mathfrak{P}$ of tiles with a surjective map $\mathcal{I} : \mathfrak{P} \to \{\text{cubes}\}$ and a map $\mathcal{Q} : \mathfrak{P} \to \Theta$ whose range is contained in the range of $Q$; write $\mathfrak{s}(p) = s(\mathcal{I}(p))$ and $\mathfrak{c}(p) = c(\mathcal{I}(p))$.
(iii) a map $\Omega : \mathfrak{P} \to \mathcal{P}(\Theta)$ such that: for every cube $I$, the range of $Q$ is contained in $\bigcup_{p : \mathcal{I}(p) = I} \Omega(p)$; if $p \ne p'$ and $\mathcal{I}(p) = \mathcal{I}(p')$ then $\Omega(p) \cap \Omega(p') = \emptyset$; if $\mathcal{I}(p) \le \mathcal{I}(p')$ then $\Omega(p) \cap \Omega(p') = \emptyset$ or $\Omega(p') \subseteq \Omega(p)$; and $B_{\mathfrak{c}(p), D^{\mathfrak{s}(p)}/4}(\mathcal{Q}(p), 1/5) \subseteq \Omega(p) \subseteq B_{\mathfrak{c}(p), D^{\mathfrak{s}(p)}/4}(\mathcal{Q}(p), 1)$, where $B_{x,r}(\vartheta,\rho)$ is the open ball in $(\Theta, d_{x,r})$.
For $p \in \mathfrak{P}$ let $E(p) = \{x \in \mathcal{I}(p) : Q(x) \in \Omega(p),\ \sigma_1(x) \le \mathfrak{s}(p) \le \sigma_2(x)\}$, and for $s \in \mathbb{Z}$, $x, y \in X$ let $K_s(x,y) = K(x,y)\,\psi(D^{-s}\mathrm{dist}(x,y))$, where $\psi$ is the project's function `ψ` with parameter $D$. Tiles are partially ordered by $p \le p'$ iff $\mathcal{I}(p) \le \mathcal{I}(p')$ and $\Omega(p') \subseteq \Omega(p)$. For $l \in \mathbb{R}$ and $p \in \mathfrak{P}$ write $\lambda_l(p) = (\mathcal{I}(p), B_{\mathfrak{c}(p), D^{\mathfrak{s}(p)}/4}(\mathcal{Q}(p), l))$ (the project's `smul l p`), and order such pairs by $(I, A) \le (J, B)$ iff $I \le J$ and $B \subseteq A$. Let $Z = 2^{12a}$.
An $n$-forest $t$ (for $n \in \mathbb{N}$; the project structure `Forest X n`) consists of a set $\mathfrak{U}_t \subseteq \mathfrak{P}$ and a map $\mathfrak{T}_t : \mathfrak{P} \to \mathcal{P}(\mathfrak{P})$ such that for all $u \in \mathfrak{U}_t$: $\mathfrak{T}_t(u)$ is nonempty and order-connected; every $p \in \mathfrak{T}_t(u)$ has $\mathcal{I}(p) \ne \mathcal{I}(u)$, $\lambda_4(p) \le \lambda_1(u)$ and $B(\mathfrak{c}(p), 8D^{\mathfrak{s}(p)}) \subseteq \mathcal{I}(u)$; and $\mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak{T}_t(u)) \le 2^{4a - n + 1}$; moreover every $x \in X$ lies in the cubes $\mathcal{I}(u)$ of at most $2^n$ tiles $u \in \mathfrak{U}_t$; and whenever $u, u' \in \mathfrak{U}_t$, $u \ne u'$, $p \in \mathfrak{T}_t(u')$ and $\mathcal{I}(p) \le \mathcal{I}(u)$, then $2^{Z(n+1)} < d_{\mathfrak{c}(p), D^{\mathfrak{s}(p)}/4}(\mathcal{Q}(p), \mathcal{Q}(u))$. Here, for $\mathfrak{P}' \subseteq \mathfrak{P}$, $\mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak{P}') = \sup_{p' \in \mathfrak{P}'} \sup_{l \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0},\, l \ge 2} l^{-a} \sup\{\mu(E_2(l,p))/\mu(\mathcal{I}(p)) : p \in \mathfrak{P},\ \exists p'' \in \mathfrak{P}' \text{ with } \mathcal{I}(p) \le \mathcal{I}(p''),\ \lambda_l(p') \le \lambda_l(p)\} \in [0,\infty]$, with $E_2(l,p) = \mathcal{I}(p) \cap G \cap Q^{-1}(B_{\mathfrak{c}(p), D^{\mathfrak{s}(p)}/4}(\mathcal{Q}(p), l))$. We write $u \in t$ for $u \in \mathfrak{U}_t$. An $n$-row is an $n$-forest whose tiles $u \in \mathfrak{U}$ have pairwise disjoint cubes $\mathcal{I}(u)$.
For $\mathfrak{S} \subseteq \mathfrak{P}$ let $\mathcal{Z}(\mathfrak{S})$ (the project's `rowDecomp_zornset`) be the family of sets $\mathfrak{R} \subseteq \mathfrak{S}$ such that the cubes $\mathcal{I}(u)$, $u \in \mathfrak{R}$, are pairwise disjoint and each $u \in \mathfrak{R}$ has $\mathcal{I}(u)$ maximal (for $\le$) among the cubes $\{\mathcal{I}(v) : v \in \mathfrak{S}\}$. For an $n$-forest $t$, $\mathfrak{U}_{t,j} = \mathrm{rowDecomp}_{\mathfrak{U}}(t,j)$ is defined by strong recursion on $j \in \mathbb{N}$: it is a chosen inclusion-maximal element of $\mathcal{Z}\big(\mathfrak{U}_t \setminus \bigcup_{i < j} \mathfrak{U}_{t,i}\big)$. So, for $n \in \mathbb{N}$, an $n$-forest $t$ and $j \in \mathbb{N}$, $\mathrm{rowDecomp}_{\mathfrak{U}}(t,j) \subseteq \mathfrak{P}$ is this chosen maximal set of tiles of $\mathfrak{U}_t$, not in any earlier $\mathrm{rowDecomp}_{\mathfrak{U}}(t,i)$ with $i < j$, with pairwise disjoint cubes each maximal among the cubes of the remaining tiles.
